marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Leading US technology conglomerates reported elevated capital expenditures dedicated to AI data centers and hardware infrastructure, alongside stable enterprise cloud revenue growth.
marketLayer.inference: High capital spending may compress short-term margins for hyperscalers, but guarantees sustained order momentum for semiconductor design and hardware supply chains globally.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: The speed of software-side AI monetization and the ROI timeline for enterprise end-users.

marketLayer.title: HK Internet Equities & Share Buyback Support
marketLayer.fact: Major Hong Kong-listed tech leaders expanded their active stock buyback programs to historical highs while deepening cross-border e-commerce initiatives.
marketLayer.inference: Continuous corporate repurchases establish a firm valuation floor for the Hang Seng Tech Index, attracting southbound capital inflows despite macro headwinds.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Trajectory of Chinese domestic retail consumption recovery and potential international trade policy shifts.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Rate Path & Global Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: U.S. inflation metrics continue a gradual descent toward target levels amid moderating labor market data, keeping market expectations for rate cuts intact.
marketLayer.inference: Easing global yields improve capital liquidity across emerging Asia and Hong Kong markets, benefiting rate-sensitive sectors such as biotech and HK REITs.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential re-acceleration of sticky services inflation or unexpected hawkish shifts in Fed guidance.
